mechanical_intent.role: fixed base flange of an articulated industrial robot arm; anchors the arm and carries the J0 revolute output toward L1
mechanical_intent.geometry_intent: circular flange plate with four corner mounting ears, central raised cylindrical hub, and a top interface boss aligned with the J0 axis

interface_constraints.constraint: Top hub face must be planar and normal to Z at height 0.06858 m; coaxial with Z axis; bearing seat / boss concentric within 0.05 mm; bolt circle provided for L1 attachment; flipped orientation (rpy pi about X) accounted for so the joint frame points downward from the hub face.

operations.description: Sketch base flange profile on XY plane: circle of diameter ~110 mm centered at origin, unioned with four rectangular ear tabs extending to corners at 45 deg offsets.
Extrude flange profile symmetric ~12 mm to form the base plate with ears.
Add one through-hole (~5 mm) on each ear tab, then CircularPattern 4x about Z at 90 deg spacing for base mounting bolts.
Revolve a profile about Z from the flange top to create the central raised cylindrical hub, outer diameter ~70 mm, rising to the J0 interface height 0.06858 m; BooleanUnion with flange.
Cut a concentric counterbore/recess in the hub top face to seat the J0 bearing/output interface, depth ~8 mm, diameter per joint bolt circle bore.
Cut rectangular side port cutouts through the hub walls (two opposing ports) for cable routing and weight reduction, per visual observation.
Fillet (~4 mm) the junctions between ear tabs and flange rim, and fillet hub-to-plate transition to reduce stress concentration.
Chamfer (~1.5 mm) the hub top rim and flange outer edge for deburring and assembly clearance.

prohibited_input_ack: No GT mesh, original CAD, product identity, or hidden labels were used.
